senses.gloss: ch. same, to join, associate. [Targ. Prov. XXIII, 32 some ed., read נכת.]—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:6:3">Y. Keth. V, 30ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חכים אנא לנשייא דצַבְתָן עם וכ׳</he> (not <he>דצבתין</he>) I knew the women that kept my mother company (during her confinement), v. <cite ref="H00940"><he>חֲכַם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 60a:2">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>בעינא דאִיצְבֵּית ליה נהמא וכ׳</he> I desire to offer bread (to sacrifice) to your God; <he>פוק צְבִית לגידא וכ׳</he> go out and offer up at the banks (or landing) of the Rabitha where there is a wide plain.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:14">M. Kat. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>צבית זוודתא לאודך</he> ed. (read: <he>צְבִיתִי</he>; Ms. M. <he>תימוש האי וכ׳</he>) prepare a shroud for thy other son.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 80a">B. Bath. 80ᵃ</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="R00182"><he>צְוַות</he></cite>.
